units: <cite ref="Shabbat 152a:11">Ib. 152ᵃ</cite> (ref. to <cite ref="Ecclesiastes 12:5">Koh. XII, 5</cite> <he>מגבוה ייראו</he>) <he>שאפי׳ ג׳ קטנה וכ׳</he> even a small mound appears to him (the aged man) like the highest mountains.
<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Eruvin 2:1:6">Y. Erub. II, 20ᵃ</cite>, opp. <cite ref="H01690"><he>חָרִיץ</he></cite>.—Pl. <cite ref="C00144"><he>גַּבְשׁוּשִׁיּוֹת</he></cite>.
<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Sotah 7:3:2">Y. Sot. VII, 21ᶜ</cite> <he>שתי ג׳ וכ׳</he> (not … <he>שית</he>) they put up two mounds and named them Mount Gerizim &c.
